thread:
josh: Heads-up: deploying a new dedicated GPU family today — G7s-Lite (internal: 'Orchid'). Rolling out as preview in São Paulo (GRU) and Seoul (ICN). Focus is low-latency chat + streaming embeds.

leila: Rollout plan: GRU @ 03:30 UTC, ICN @ 07:00 UTC. Pools will appear as tag `g7sl-preview`. 48h preview burst window.

chris: Capacity numbers?

josh: GRU: 32 cards (4 racks). ICN: 28 cards (3 racks). Expect ~1.4x throughput vs our previous L-series on short sequences. Memory footprint lower on int8 paths.

leila: Policy note: starting next Monday new reservations require `workload_class` tag (dev/staging/prod). Existing reservations have a 60-day grace. Run `infractl tag --reservation R-XXXXX --workload prod` to update.

infra-bot: Reminder: reservation-tag-audit scheduled 2026-04-03T12:00:00Z. Reports will be sent to #eng-sre and #ops.

josh: Perf tuning: try q4_0 first. If you see quality issues, runtime will autofall back to q8_0. Please file feedback in the preview doc.

leila: CS blurb incoming for customer outreach. Ops will pin dashboards 10 minutes before each stage.
